title: Concerns around premium
body: Paid for lifetime premium access once, it got removed after a few years. Paid for it once more, never received the premium version. Also reached out to support but never heard back.
author: L-L9904

title: Don't buy premium version
body:
Once you buy a premium version to add more than 3 habits it propose's you to buy a bundle of apps from the developer. If you click cancel the process restarts and you never end up actually using premium features :(

Very sad, since otherwise would have been a great app...
author: Jan Dzhem
